meta.title: GitHub manager
meta.description: Full-permission GitHub management: browser OAuth (repo, delete_repo, workflow, admin:public_key, gist, notifications) with an AES-256-GCM encrypted local vault, multi-account switching and removal, and a complete agent toolset to create/delete repositories, read/write/delete code, add or remove SSH and GPG keys, deploy keys and Actions secrets, and trigger workflows. gh_api reaches any REST endpoint. Everything runs on the OAuth token — no gh CLI and no separate PAT.
